What is web and mobile app development?

Web development is the process related to developing websites for the web (World Wide Web) or an intranet (a private network). This process includes web design, web content development, client-side/server-side scripting, and network security configuration, among other tasks.
Mobile app development is the work involved in developing a mobile app for mobile devices, like personal digital assistants, enterprise digital assistants or mobile phones.
Which is the best app development or web development?

Web apps are less costly to develop than mobile apps. Mobile apps are platform- specific and you need to study Java and XML to develop Android Application. Mobile apps are much faster than web apps, and more advanced in features and functionality.
Is Web development easier than mobile development?

Programming language for Web app development includes JavaScript, CSS and HTML5. Compared to mobile apps, web apps don’t have any standard software development kit. Web apps are easier to develop but they’re much simpler in terms of features.
